tactics: induction l generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.replace_cons] <;> split <;> simp_all

induction l generalizing i with
| nil => simp
| cons x xs ih =>
  cases i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    simp only [List.take_succ_cons, List.replace_cons]
    split <;> simp_all
